name: johnny-monkey
description: Educational platform with database backup integration

scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm start --prefix client"
scripts.sync:sounds: git fetch origin main && git checkout origin/main -- client/src/lib/presentationSound.ts client/src/components/presentation/PresentationSoundControls.tsx client/src/App.tsx client/src/pages/PresentationEditorPage.tsx client/src/components/presentation/PresentationSlideToolsBar.tsx client/src/components/presentation/PresentationTabletToolbar.tsx client/src/components/presentation/PresentationLaptopPlayer.tsx
scripts.git:commit: bash scripts/backup-manager.sh create && git add . && git commit -m "Auto-backup: $(date)"
scripts.build: npm install && cd server && npm install && npm run prisma:generate && cd ../client && npm install && npm install --save-dev @types/file-saver && REACT_APP_API_URL=https://johnnymonkey.onrender.com npm run build && cd ../server && rm -rf client-build && cp -r ../client/build ./client-build && npm run build
scripts.build:server: cd server && npm install && npm run prisma:generate && npm run build
scripts.build:client: cd client && npm install && npm install --save-dev @types/file-saver && npm run build
scripts.deploy:build: npm install && cd server && npm install && npm run build && cd ../client && npm install && npm run build && cd ../server && rm -rf client-build && cp -r ../client/build ./client-build
